tldr: Mars in the 7th house routes drive and action through one-to-one bonds.
body: With Mars in the 7th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through partnership, marriage, clients, contracts, and open conflict. This makes how you meet others, let yourself be met, and handle equality in relationship a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through one-to-one bonds.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in one-to-one bonds.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
